messages:
Ana: Dropped a quick refresh in Figma — primary/secondary button gesture affordance iteration. link: https://figma.com/file/xxxx (page: gesture-affordance). Key asks: focus ring contrast, hit target >=44px, and copy for confirm vs save. Thoughts?

Miguel: I like the extra vertical padding. On smaller breakpoints the primary becomes too tall. Could we reduce token `--button-vertical-gap` by 2px on compact? :thinking:

Sam: Copy q — are we using "Save changes" for non-destructive flows or "Confirm" for one-off destructive ones? PM prefers explicit verbs for risky actions.

Olivia: Engineering note — current focus outline is `2px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)` which doesn't meet contrast on light surfaces. Recommend `outline: 3px solid var(--button-focus-color)` and set `--button-focus-color: #0958D9` (meets 4.5:1). Also enforce keyboard hit target min 44px.

design-bot: accessibility-checker: computed contrast — primary label: 4.6:1 (PASS), ghost/tertiary label: 3.2:1 (FAIL for normal text). Suggestion: use `text-600` token or increase ghost label weight.

Ana: Pushed new frames — reduced compact vertical gap and bumped focus color. Inline token changes:
```
--button-padding-compact: 8px 12px;
--button-focus-color: #0958D9;
```
Can folks react :eyes: if acceptable.

Miguel: @Ana can we keep a 44px hit target but visually compact — e.g. keep padding but apply `margin: -6px` around to reduce visual footprint? Risk: might break grid alignment.

Sam: Proposal on copy: default primary = "Save changes"; destructive flows use explicit labels like "Delete model" on the CTA and open a confirm modal with CTA "Confirm deletion". Less ambiguity for users.

Olivia: Implementation caveat — on mac trackpad long-press triggers tooltip and can conflict with a long-press secondary-menu gesture. If we add long-press affordance, add a 300ms debounce and keyboard fallback.

Miguel: Tech proposal: add `data-gesture="long-press-menu"` opt-in attr and a visual token `--button-gesture-indicator-size: 10px` low-contrast. Keeps it opt-in for complex controls.

Ana: New copy in Figma: primary "Save changes", secondary "Cancel", destructive CTA labeled with the action (e.g., "Delete model") + confirm modal. I'll update components and annotate tokens.

design-bot: tokens-linter: new `--button-padding-compact` passes. Reminder: register `--button-focus-color` in tokens.json per theme mapping.

Olivia: I'll open a WIP PR with CSS, keyboard/a11y tests, and a tiny demo page. Can someone add two design testcases: stacked buttons inside narrow cards and compact table row actions? Thanks :thumbsup:

Miguel: Adding testcases now.

Sam: SGTM, will sync copy changes with doc and product examples.

Ana: Thanks all — I'll ship the figma updates and tag reviewers. :sparkles:
